pytorch_phase_peaks.label: B1000
pytorch_phase_peaks.peak_scope: One loaded model plus actual fixed forwards and readout capture; phase peak reset after load. Instrumented timing not a speed benchmark.

pytorch_phase_peaks.label: C1000
pytorch_phase_peaks.peak_scope: One loaded model plus actual fixed forwards and readout capture; phase peak reset after load. Instrumented timing not a speed benchmark.

resources.interpretation: PyTorch counters reset after each model load; include resident tensors and instrumented capture, not complete load-time or per-process VRAM. Device samples include other processes/desktop and are sampled, not a continuous process peak. Different B/C allocated peaks do not establish a retention cause or isolated per-model cost. Instrumented times are not inference benchmarks.
